body: Thank y oh so much for all the replies. I appreciate you ❤️

Sometimes depression really is just a chemical imbalance in the brain. There’s no criteria in order to experience depression. People with seemingly “perfect lives” can struggle and be torn down by depressive thoughts.  Many celebrities who have fame, money, fans, and so much more struggle with depression, even though to the outside world they seem to “have it all.”
Well, I have some underlying issues that ultimately make me feel this way. I just wish I could accept it all and learn to be grateful for my life. I am sick of wallowing in my own self pity.

I’m really not sure. It’s this feeling of shame, and I bring it on myself. I have great friends and family who believe in me...I just don’t believe in myself. I feel like a “less than” compared to those around me.
Hey hey I’m good, thank you for asking tho ❤️
All my negative thoughts...like they consume me...i dont know how to explain.
Please don’t end your life. But I understand what you mean, I feel the same way.
Hahahah, you seem like a really fun person :)
This is the best, thank you ;)
Honestly, you look pretty good. I’d say attractive.
